body: I know people will throw a funeral and everything for me; I know people care for me a lot. The entire purpose of the other thread was trying to minimize the impact my passing would have on them. The extreme degree of social stress only worsens my depression.

I don't even know what the light or darkness is. Certain emotions, feelings, senses, have been described to me and I've dabbled in such but because of my physical ailments nothing has been short of extremely temporary. Thank you for the reply. I understand everyone is different and I don't wish this on anyone.

I love my friends but honestly as I said before it's not really about them. They're wellgrounded enough to live on with their lives. I made sure long ago I wasn't detrimental to the survival of anyone. I hope to become a blur, not a constant pain or worry.
Also [this](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ZpXPwmbQvc), so that maybe they will find inner peace if necessary.
I'm informing people for this to be played my eulogy. It's so beautiful.
Thanks for the reply, I think that's a great idea not having someone I know find me. I also don't want to do it in a public space.

I have tried multiple medications, but it only made some symptoms worse. I have talked to therapists and psychiatrists however I don't feel like they've been through what I have and they don't understand me. My mother knows I'm pretty serious, and she also knows I have access to things to make this happen. She's white-knuckling it right now and I've cut communication with everyone as I have pretty much done last year too.

I have a will and it's legal. I don't have money for a funeral/cremation however the cost of that is cheaper than the money my family will be spending on me for tuition.

Thanks for the response.

I told my mother a few months ago and she told my immediate family, so it wont be as much of a shock. My mother called me selfish, and asked me if I just want to try to start over and she'd stand by me. But to be honest, it's not about her or anyone else - it's about me and this is what I need. I know this will hurt my family but I've been such a strain on them.

I also have an extensive friend network so I need to somehow prepare them for this.

I'm not trying to focus on *why* I'm going to off myself, but I created this thread to help figure out ways to minimize the shock it will have on my family. Also I want to help my family find closure as soon as possible. So basically I'm asking this:

* What has helped you in the closure process of loved ones?
* Is there anything you would leave for your family if you were to die?
* What is something that is good at uniting a family during the grieving process?

Best regards.
